# Vendor Portal Feature

Dedicated portal for vendors to manage halls, catering menus, photo galleries, booking dates, incoming customer inquiries, and revenue trends.

## Contents
- `VendorHeader.jsx`: Vendor navigation bar, active tab indicators, and unread notification badge.
- `VendorHome.jsx`: Summary dashboard displaying active branches, latest bookings, and unread inquiries.
- `VendorHalls.jsx`: Branch management (add/edit halls and caterers, address, capacity, pricing).
- `VendorDetails.jsx`: Previous works gallery and photo uploader.
- `VendorBookings.jsx`: Calendar bookings table with status toggling (confirmed, completed, cancelled).
- `VendorRequests.jsx`: Customer chat inbox with contact violation filters and response threads.
- `VendorRevenue.jsx`: Monthly revenue charts, completed booking totals, and earnings analytics.
- `VendorProfile.jsx`: Vendor account details and document verification status.
- `rajahmundryOfflineData.js` & `kadapaOfflineData.js`: Pre-seeded branch and pricing records.
- `vendor.css`: Complete styling for vendor dashboard, forms, cards, tables, and buttons.
